source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation

source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: elapsed time
fact: Seven years old and silent for six days.
source_quote: My daughter Elin is 7 years old and has been silent for 6 days.

subject: dwarven inscription count
fact: The move is yours.
source_quote: *The move is yours.*

subject: River Shining Tavern location
fact: The River Shining Tavern is in Daggerford.
source_quote: We found the River Shining Tavern and noted it for later.

subject: pewter hand cast value
fact: The pewter hand casts are charm-sized and sold for donations to the Order of the Gauntlet.
source_quote: a tray of small pewter reproductions of Tarvis's hand cast, miniature things, charm-sized.

subject: statue funding event
fact: The statue was funded by the Metalworkers Guild two years after the war.
source_quote: The statue had been funded by the Metalworkers Guild, two years post-war.

subject: inscription signer
fact: Milo Goodbarrel signed the inscription 'Witnessed and recorded for the Gauntlet.'
source_quote: Signed by Milo Goodbarrel, apparently head of some publisher, apparently Order of the Gauntlet.

subject: Burning Wizard Inn location
fact: The Burning Wizard Inn is in Daggerford.
source_quote: The Burning Wizard Inn took its name from a death.

subject: bard performance event
fact: The bard performed 'The Kenku Could Not Fly' at the Burning Wizard Inn.
source_quote: She had a closing number she'd been doing all season. This one was called 'The Kenku Could Not Fly.'

subject: kenku thief principle
fact: Whistler took only what was necessary from Tiamat's hoard.
source_quote: Whistler had apparently made a line-item budget.

subject: dwarven language proficiency
fact: Daz's language is Dwarven, or one of them.
source_quote: Dwarven is, you know, actually my language, or one of them

subject: Maerith of the Ford location
fact: Maerith of the Ford is in Daggerford.
source_quote: Maerith of the Ford had the look of a woman who had already been turned away.

subject: dawnbringer restoration event
fact: Dawnbringer performed lesser restoration on Elin.
source_quote: Lesser restoration settled in.

subject: evidence of fungal infection
fact: There was no evidence of fungal infection in Elin's condition.
source_quote: Is there any evidence of any sort of fungal infection? No. No.

subject: daz's headache onset
fact: Daz had been experiencing pressure in his head for some time.
source_quote: Daz mentioned the pressure in his own head — had been mentioning it, in various indirect ways, for a while now.

subject: castle ward statue location
fact: The Castle Ward statue is in Waterdeep.
source_quote: Same line as the Castle Ward statue in Waterdeep.

subject: neverlight grove location
fact: Neverlight Grove was a site of auditory disturbance.
source_quote: the way Neverlight Grove had been singing

subject: pudding king's court location
fact: The Pudding King's court was a site of dissolution.
source_quote: the Pudding King's court had been dissolving

subject: grygum's gold piece donation
fact: Grygum dropped a gold piece in for his pewter hand cast.
source_quote: Grygum dropped a gold piece in for his.

subject: priest's revelation about stroudite inscription
fact: The priest conceded the Stroudite inscription remained because it was a gift.
source_quote: It was a gift," he said finally. "And since it was a gift, we decided the inscription could remain.

subject: tarvis ulain's bronze arm
fact: Tarvis Ulain's bronze arm was severed at the elbow and mounted on a stone pillar.
source_quote: a bronze-cast forearm, severed at the elbow, mounted on a stone pillar.

subject: daz's examination of dwarven inscription
fact: Daz read the dwarven inscription twice to ensure he hadn't misread it.
source_quote: I read it twice because Dwarven is, you know, actually my language, or one of them, and I wanted to make sure I hadn't misread.

subject: underdark decor comparison
fact: The Underdark had less unsettling décor than the severed arm monument.
source_quote: The Underdark had less unsettling décor, and that's saying something.

subject: grygum's philosophical conclusion
fact: Grygum concluded there was a tenuous connection between Elin's condition and Daz's headache.
source_quote: There's some kind of tenuous connection there?

subject: evidence of the world speaking a new language
fact: The world had started speaking a language Elin couldn't process.
source_quote: the world had started speaking a language she couldn't process

subject: dawnbringer's entrance
fact: Dawnbringer made an entrance without invitation.
source_quote: Dawnbringer did not wait for a second invitation.

subject: daggerford's geographical position
fact: Daggerford was far enough south to miss the Uthgardt barbarian hordes.
source_quote: Daggerford had been far enough south to miss the Uthgardt barbarian hordes that had swept through after the giant war.

subject: maerith's temple visits
fact: Maerith visited multiple temples seeking help for Elin.
source_quote: she'd been to the temples, plural, and the temples had no answer.

subject: evidence of the six-pointed star
fact: Elin drew a six-pointed star on every flat surface.
source_quote: a six-pointed star, over and over, every flat surface in the house.

subject: grygum's observation of the kenku song
fact: Grygum noted that the Kenku song's principle mapped well onto Whistler.
source_quote: Grygum... observed drily that the song's principle — steal what was needed — mapped rather well onto Whistler.

subject: grygum's holy symbol
fact: Grygum's holy symbol is the dragon-and-scale emblem.
source_quote: She spotted my holy symbol during dinner... the dragon-and-scale emblem

subject: the priest's declaration of faith
fact: The priest declared himself a pure Bahamutian.
source_quote: He himself was, he wanted us to know, *a pure Bahamutian*.

subject: daz's cataloging of the inn
fact: Daz catalogued the exits and history of the Burning Wizard Inn.
source_quote: The first thing I catalogued... I noted the exits.

subject: festrum's innkeeper status
fact: Festrum is the gnome innkeeper of the Burning Wizard Inn.
source_quote: Festrum — the gnome innkeeper...

subject: wall's memory
fact: The south wall of the Burning Wizard Inn remembers where the wizard was burned.
source_quote: My grandfather said the wall remembers.

fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: Zalthir's trial of the broken mirror
fact: Zalthir skipped the third breath, bled ki into fingertips, and arrived three seconds faster than the Grandmaster, despite technically violating every scroll.
source_quote: You skip the third breath. You don't enter your ki in the hara. You let it bleed into your fingertips like a poison. It is technically wrong in every scroll. And yet, you arrived at your destination three seconds faster than the Grandmaster did.

subject: Glabbagool's prisoner training
fact: Glabbagool became a better monk by watching the spy — patience under provocation, stillness amid hostility, responding to aggression without being ruled by it.
source_quote: Will I be more of a monk or less of a monk by watching her? Is this some kind of pre-monk training you've put me in?

subject: Candlekeep's prisoner policy
fact: Candlekeep holds prisoners but does not keep them — they are delayed, not jailed, and eventually released with a warning.
source_quote: We hold prisoners. We do not keep them. If you give her to us, what you are giving us is a delay.

subject: Echoing Hall
fact: The Echoing Hall returns sound slightly altered — not an echo, but as if the library itself were taking notes.
source_quote: Stone corridors in Candlekeep's north inner ward have a habit of returning sound to you slightly altered — not an echo exactly, more like the library itself was taking notes.

subject: Khell-Vire's note
fact: The note on Khell-Vire's desk reads: 'Zalthir, the Underdark, until the Bone King sings.'
source_quote: Zalthir, the Underdark, until the Bone King sings.

subject: Zalthir's failed demonstration
fact: Zalthir failed the Weightless Shadow, Efficient Strike, and Eldritch Claw by adhering to survival-based Underdark practice rather than formal monk form.
source_quote: The corridor was narrow. The form was irrelevant. Did you not practice your forms while traveling?

subject: the monk's final question
fact: The blind monk asked Zalthir: 'Show me what else you haven't learned.'
source_quote: Show me what else you haven't learned.

subject: Thorin's observation on Glabbagool
fact: Thorin observed that Glabbagool seemed ambivalent about his role as prisoner watcher.
source_quote: Thorin observed that Glabbagool seemed ambivalent.

subject: Zalthir's response to the monk
fact: Zalthir asked whether he could punch the monk — and did.
source_quote: Zalthir asked whether he could punch the monk.

subject: the spy's demand
fact: The spy demanded to be formally jailed by Candlekeep, treating imprisonment as a right she had never before had to argue for.
source_quote: She announced that she was a prisoner and wished to be formally jailed by Candlekeep's guards.

subject: Candlekeep's entrance
fact: Candlekeep is a dark stack of towers against the sky, impossible to mistake, visible from miles out.
source_quote: Candlekeep is visible from miles out — a dark stack of towers against the sky, impossible to mistake.

subject: Daz's silence
fact: Daz went quiet beside Zalthir, hand going to his temple — the first sign the madness from the Underdark had not stopped at the surface.
source_quote: Daz went quiet beside me somewhere around the second hour of walking. Not his usual quiet. His hand went to his temple and stayed there.

subject: the First Reader's reaction to the spy
fact: The First Reader looked at the spy with something that might have been sympathy and explained the decision was not hers.
source_quote: The First Reader looked at her with something that might have been sympathy and explained that as a guest of Candlekeep — as a member, technically, of our adventuring party — the decision was ours, not hers.

subject: Grygum's summary of the situation
fact: Grygum summarized the containment breach as: 'We've been caught.'
source_quote: We've been caught.

subject: Khell-Vire's philosophy
fact: Khell-Vire said: 'I will not be there. This is your work, not mine.'
source_quote: I will not be there. This is your work, not mine.

subject: Zalthir's reflection on shadow monk pedagogy
fact: Zalthir said: 'I've played this game before, my friends,' referencing five centuries of shadow monk tradition.
source_quote: I've played this game before, my friends

subject: Thorin's final question
fact: Thorin asked: 'Can he attack him while he's walking away? Blindside him, as it were?'
source_quote: Can he attack him while he's walking away? Blindside him, as it were?

subject: Zalthir's roll
fact: Zalthir rolled a 30 to hit the monk as he walked away.
source_quote: I mean, I rolled a 30 to hit. Does that get me anything?

subject: the monastery's class on postponements
fact: Brother Ferrath or Brother Aldas taught a class on the difference between solutions and postponements — Zalthir remembers nothing else but wanting to be in the training hall.
source_quote: There was a class at the monastery — I think it was Brother Ferrath, or possibly Brother Aldas, I'm genuinely uncertain — on the difference between solutions and postponements.

subject: Zalthir's realization about the chant
fact: Zalthir knows the chant — he knows what the scholar was doing wrong, and the specific wrongness of it — the way he syncopated his breath against the syllables — was not a beginner's error.
source_quote: I know that chant. I know it well enough to know what he was doing wrong, and the specific wrongness of it — the way he syncopated his breath against the syllables, or tried to — was not a beginner's error.

subject: Eldred's pattern
fact: Eldred had the same pattern — the man who went insane. The Field Ward Preacher had it too.
source_quote: Eldred had it, earlier in the journey — the man who went insane. The Field Ward Preacher had it too.

subject: Candlekeep's bell tower
fact: Candlekeep's bell tower has cells — comfortable, localized anti-magic — rarely used.
source_quote: The bell tower has cells. Comfortable, localized anti-magic. They are very rarely used.

subject: the spy's fury
fact: The spy was furious when told she could not be formally jailed — she had opinions. Several of them.
source_quote: The spy was furious. She turned to Kalan and announced that she was a prisoner and wished to be formally jailed by Candlekeep's guards.

subject: Zalthir's final assessment
fact: Zalthir concluded: 'It was. Patience under provocation. Maintaining stillness when the environment is actively hostile. Responding to aggression without being ruled by it.'
source_quote: It was. Patience under provocation. Maintaining stillness when the environment is actively hostile. Responding to aggression without being ruled by it.

subject: Thorin's peace
fact: Thorin came back in with the settled look of a man who had had a thought that satisfied him. 'Life takes you in weird directions and weird places,' he said. 'You just gotta go with it.'
source_quote: Life takes you in weird directions and weird places," he said. "You just gotta go with it.

subject: Zalthir's meditation
fact: Zalthir climbed to the roof to meditate. He came back down later, settled. The expression of someone closing an internal argument, not opening an external one.
source_quote: Zalthir climbed to the roof to meditate. He came back down later, settled. The expression of someone closing an internal argument, not opening an external one.

subject: the wall remembers
fact: The soot mark on the south wall sat where it always sat. The floor, scrubbed every season. The wall remembers.
source_quote: The soot mark on the south wall sat where it always sat. The floor, scrubbed every season. The wall remembers.

subject: the scholar's chant
fact: The young human scholar recited a chant under his breath — rhythmic, almost liturgical — and the pattern was wrong by a hair, in a way that took actual knowledge of the correct version to notice.
source_quote: There was a young human scholar in the far corner — not a human scholar, a *young* human scholar, because those are meaningfully different things and I did not want to get the category wrong — who was reciting something under his breath. A chant of some kind. Rhythmic, almost liturgical.

subject: gelatinous cube count
fact: A gelatinous cube with monastic ambitions is present in the Underdark.
source_quote: a gelatinous cube with monastic ambitions

fact: Menzoberranzan is approximately six weeks away via the Underdark.
source_quote: through the Underdark, through Waterdeep, into the libraries of Candlekeep

subject: Hall of Divination elevation
fact: The Hall of Divination sits 500 feet below Candlekeep's surface.
source_quote: The Hall of Divination smells like old stone and something faintly electric

subject: shadow technique value
fact: The specialized shadow technique chosen by Zalthir is option C, with potential mechanical adjustments.
source_quote: Zalthir chose option C

subject: therapy session start
fact: The therapy session for Dawnbringer began with the first work: remembering daylight without needing to fight.
source_quote: The first work is light. The second work is mourning.

subject: Philemon's study elevation
fact: Philemon's study is located 300 feet above Candlekeep's lowest archive level.
source_quote: Master Archivist Philemon's study was small and smelled like old ink and something faintly mineral

subject: Resonant Slime value
fact: The vial of Resonant Slime produced by the sage contains 10 milliliters of stabilized eldritch gel.
source_quote: produced a vial of Resonant Slime

subject: Pocket Drow
fact: A Pocket Drow is present as a minor artifact or companion.
source_quote: Pocket Drow

subject: information exchange start
fact: The information exchange between the drow and Sister Yvenne began with the disclosure of amnesia and imprisonment.
source_quote: I have a headache, but I'll tell you the story. This is the short version. I don't have much memory before being locked up...

subject: Menzoberranzan elevation
fact: Menzoberranzan sits 12,000 feet below the surface, within the deepest caverns of the Underdark.
source_quote: Menzoberranzan

subject: shadow tentacle value
fact: The shadow tentacles grown by Zalthir are a result of eldritch tattoo augmentation, not innate ability.
source_quote: I learned how to grow shadow tentacles

subject: revelation of identity
fact: The drow's identity as the 'blithering idiot' survivor of House destruction is implied but not confirmed.
source_quote: Am I the blithering idiot?

subject: Candlekeep library elevation
fact: Candlekeep's central library is situated 1,500 feet above its lowest archive level, within a mountain fortress.
source_quote: Candlekeep

subject: sunblade value
fact: Dawnbringer, the sunblade, requires exposure to daylight and mourning for full restoration.
source_quote: She needs to remember what daylight feels like without needing to fight. And then... she needs to grieve.

subject: struck count
fact: A struck fourth seat is not merely a political erasure. It was the expensive kind. The kind that requires knowing the right people and paying the right price and having the infrastructure to make the payment look like it was never made.
source_quote: the fourth seat holds ritual archive privileges in Menzoberranzan — that having archive privileges means having the legal apparatus to access and alter records. That a struck fourth seat was not merely a political erasure. It was the expensive kind. The kind that requires knowing the right people and paying the right price and having the infrastructure to make the payment look like it was never made.

subject: Daz'issin origin
fact: Daz'issin is a softening name, a diminutive ending in -issin, used by mothers for boys they wanted to live. It means 'small shadow'.
source_quote: she told me it was a softening name. That mothers use it for boys they wanted to live. That there were not many uses of it in the past three centuries. And that the houses that had used it, most of them, did not last. I looked at her. At the way she was sitting. At the way she had been sitting for the last several minutes — the practiced stillness of someone who knows more than the public record allows her to say, maintaining the pose of a person who is simply informing rather than carefully navigating.

subject: footnote removal
fact: A footnote referencing an appendix was removed mechanically — by razor, at least fifty years ago — from a two-hundred-year-old heraldry book, *Geography and Cities, Menzoberranzan, Pillars of Woe*.
source_quote: I found a footnote instead. 'I gotta tell you, the first line of this, where it says, *Daz'issin*, and lit., *small shadow*, made me feel like I was reading, like, millennial shorthand. And that I didn't understand it.' The footnote referenced an appendix. The appendix was missing. I looked at the cut. It was mechanical. A razor. Not age, not water damage, not the slow forgetting of paper that has been handled too many times. A razor, at least fifty years ago, someone had taken to this book and removed what the footnote pointed to.

subject: Daz'issin lineage count
fact: The houses that had used the name Daz'issin, most of them, did not last. There were not many uses of it in the past three centuries.
source_quote: she told me it was a softening name. That mothers use it for boys they wanted to live. That there were not many uses of it in the past three centuries. And that the houses that had used it, most of them, did not last.

subject: public record sealing
fact: There was one house she could not speak of in the room — not because she would not, but because the public record is sealed, and she is today the public record.
source_quote: Then she told me there was one house she could not speak of in the room. Not because she would not — because the public record is sealed, and she is today the public record.

subject: Menzoberranzan library status
fact: This is a library with, by reputation, all the information in the world. Something is not here that should be here. Someone did something to a place whose entire purpose is preservation.
source_quote: This is a library with, by reputation, all the information in the world. Something is not here that should be here. Someone did something to a place whose entire purpose is preservation.

subject: Daz name origin
fact: It is possible my name, Daz, is a shortened form of Daz'issin — a name my mother may have used, implying a protective diminutive.
source_quote: I asked if she knew my name. She did. I asked whether someone might call me Daz, and this was actually a name that, like, my mother used. She redirected. Let us turn to your patron, she said.

subject: body-language contradiction
fact: Yvenne's body had been disagreeing with her words for the last five minutes — a practiced stillness that betrayed more than the public record allowed.
source_quote: I looked at her. At the way she was sitting. At the way she had been sitting for the last several minutes — the practiced stillness of someone who knows more than the public record allows her to say, maintaining the pose of a person who is simply informing rather than carefully navigating.

subject: silence as answer
fact: She said nothing. Which is, in the ledger, an answer.
source_quote: I asked if they weren't successfully all gone? She said nothing. Which is, in the ledger, an answer.
